# Hand-checkable case shared by the Python tests and the Java SelfCheck.
# vm <mips> <price_per_second> <host_id>
vm 1000 0.001 0
vm 500 0.0005 1
# host <id> <p_idle_w> <p_max_w>
host 0 100 200
host 1 50 100
# task <length_mi> <arrival_s> <deadline_s>
task 2000 0 3
task 1000 0 1.5
task 1000 1 2.5
# a fixed assignment (VM index per task) and its hand-computed objectives
assign 0 1 0
expect makespan 3.0
# energy: a host is on from its first task start to its last finish (host 1: 0-2 s, host 0: 0-3 s)
#   host 0: idle 100 W x 3 s + (200-100) W x (3000 MI / 1000 MIPS) = 300 + 300 = 600 J
#   host 1: idle  50 W x 2 s + (100-50)  W x (1000 MI /  500 MIPS) = 100 + 100 = 200 J
expect energy 800.0
expect cost 0.004
expect imbalance 0.2
expect sla 0.6666666667
# what the baseline schedulers must produce on this instance
expect_fcfs 0 1 0
expect_minmin 0 0 0
